decisive_items: HEV IgG and IgM were positive but HEV RNA was undetectable
Ceruloplasmin and alpha-1 antitrypsin levels were normal
ANA, antimitochondrial antibody, antismooth muscle antibody, P-ANCA, C-ANCA, and anti–liver-kidney microsomal type 1 antibody were negative
response.rationale: HEV serology indicates recent infection, while other causes are ruled out by negative autoimmune markers and normal ceruloplasmin; the RNA undetectable may reflect a resolving phase but the liver injury is consistent.

rejected.why: Acute liver failure is a syndrome, not a specific cause
Only ferritin elevated, no other HLH criteria
